task_definition.task_description: Please check the current time in New York, then look up the status of flight CA1234 and, if it’s available, book that flight for John Doe. After that, check the details for Hilton Tokyo, book a stay there for John Doe from 2026-05-10 to 2026-05-15, and then create a document titled with the current time using the hotel booking ID and send me a notification.

user_input.query: Please check the current time in America/New_York, then look up the status of flight CA1234 and, if it’s available, book it for John Doe. Once that’s done, create a document titled with the current time that includes the hotel booking ID, and send a notification to user_123.
